Usage analytics

Usage analytics is optional and off by default. You can enable or disable it in the game’s Settings using “Share usage analytics”. Your choice is saved on this device.

If enabled, Google Analytics receives a pseudonymous browser identifier, visit and engagement information, device/browser information and network information needed to receive the requests. It uses cookies. The game sends a fixed page address without query strings, room codes or referral details, and does not send player names or account identifiers to Analytics. Advertising storage, advertising personalization and Google signals are disabled in the integration.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals prevent analytics from starting. Turning it off stops collection for this measurement ID and clears its analytics cookies on this site. It does not erase information already received by Google. Blocking analytics or declining it does not affect gameplay.

Online friend rooms and scores continue to use the existing game service. This change adds no Firebase sign-in, database or file-upload feature.
